title: AMConfigV1.Receivers is top-level; validation of receiver refs lives in AMConfigV1.Validate()
answers: Why can't I find cfg.AlertmanagerConfig.Receivers anymore?
Where do I add/read receivers on the internal alertmanager config model?
Where is the 'route references unknown receiver' validation done now?
How do I construct a v1.AMConfigV1 test fixture with receivers?
body:
Symptom: code written against cfg.AlertmanagerConfig.Receivers (or PostableApiAlertingConfig.Receivers) no longer compiles or silently sees no receivers; route->receiver existence validation appears to be missing.
Root cause: Receivers used to be nested inside PostableApiAlertingConfig; they were moved to a top-level field on AMConfigV1, and PostableApiAlertingConfig.Validate() lost the data it used to validate route receiver references against.
Fix pattern: read/write receivers via cfg.Receivers or cfg.GetReceivers() (pkg/services/ngalert/notifier/legacy_storage/v1/model.go:AMConfigV1), and put any route<->receiver cross-validation in AMConfigV1.Validate(), which now builds the receiver name set itself and calls c.AlertmanagerConfig.Route.ValidateReceivers(receivers).
Constraints: applies to the internal v1.AMConfigV1/PostableApiAlertingConfig model used across ngalert/notifier and ngalert/provisioning; the API/DB-facing definitions.PostableApiAlertingConfig JSON shape is unaffected (see companion note on compat.go).
applies: pkg/services/ngalert/notifier/legacy_storage/v1 and all callers in pkg/services/ngalert/notifier, pkg/services/ngalert/provisioning that build or read AMConfigV1
says: Why can't I find alert receivers in the configuration anymore
Alert routes show no receivers despite being configured
Route targets undefined receivers with no validation error thrown
Building test alert configs with receivers produces empty definitions
Receiver definitions lost during alertmanager config update or migration
search: AMConfigV1.Receivers moved from nested inside PostableApiAlertingConfig to a top-level field on AMConfigV1, and route-to-receiver validation logic must move to AMConfigV1.Validate(). Read and write receivers via cfg.Receivers or cfg.GetReceivers() (not cfg.AlertmanagerConfig.Receivers), and place any route→receiver cross-validation in AMConfigV1.Validate(), which now builds the receiver name set and calls c.AlertmanagerConfig.Route.ValidateReceivers(receivers). PostableApiAlertingConfig.Validate() no longer has the receiver data needed for validation; compat.go preserves the API/DB JSON shape unchanged. This applies to code in pkg/services/ngalert/notifier/legacy_storage/v1 and callers in ngalert/notifier and ngalert/provisioning.
